root_cause.text: The amdgpu device cleanup paths in `amdgpu_device_ip_fini_early()` and `amdgpu_device_ip_fini()` dereferenced `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` without verifying it was initialized, so unsupported hardware could leave `version` NULL and trigger a NULL pointer dereference during teardown.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit message explicitly says cleanup fails “due to a NULL version pointer on unsupported hardware,” and the patch fixes this by adding `if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version) continue;` checks before accessing `version->funcs`, `version->type`, and `version->funcs->late_fini` in the cleanup loops.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check for IP block version pointers in amdgpu_device_ip_fini_early() to avoid null dereferences during early shutdown.
intent_record.what: A new null check was added inside the loop in amdgpu_device_ip_fini_early(): before accessing adev->ip_blocks[i].version->funcs->early_fini, the code now tests whether adev->ip_blocks[i].version is null and skips that IP block with continue if it is.
intent_record.how: This prevents dereferencing a null version pointer during early finalization of IP blocks. At runtime, any IP block entry without an initialized version is now safely skipped instead of causing a crash or undefined behavior when accessing its function table.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check for ip_blocks[i].version in amdgpu_device_ip_fini() to avoid null-pointer dereferences during teardown.
intent_record.what: In amdgpu_device_ip_fini(), a new conditional check was added before dereferencing adev->ip_blocks[i].version: if the version pointer is null, the loop continues to the next IP block.
intent_record.how: This prevents the function from accessing adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type when version is unset, avoiding a possible null-pointer dereference during device IP finalization and safely skipping uninitialized or missing version entries.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null version check in IP block late teardown to prevent crashes from dereferencing missing version data.
intent_record.what: In amdgpu_device_ip_fini(), a new null check was added inside the reverse ip_blocks cleanup loop: if adev->ip_blocks[i].version is null, the loop now continues before accessing version->funcs->late_fini.
intent_record.how: This prevents dereferencing a null version pointer during late finalization of IP blocks, avoiding a potential kernel crash when a block is marked late_initialized but has no version structure.

grouping_result.intent: Add a null version check in IP block late teardown to prevent crashes from dereferencing missing version data.
